nodes.label: question_slots (Per-Question Pattern Structure)
nodes.rationale: Section-level aggregates destroyed the teacher's per-question intent, which was then guessed back by an inference chain at generation time; slots become the source of truth and legacy aggregates are derived at save time so every existing consumer keeps working; named question_slots (not questions) because the CBSE-seeded dialect already uses questions as an integer count.

nodes.label: Slot Schema (qnum/type/marks/parts/choice)
nodes.rationale: marks is always the attempted value for the printed question; parts marks-sum rules differ for open vs internal choice; ranges in source text ('Q1-4 MCQs') expand to one slot per qnum; a slot's source says where its material comes from.

nodes.label: Canonical Slot Type Enum
nodes.rationale: Free-form question types classified to 'other' in _type_category and silently disabled type-aware logic (the Tamil-paper failure); type is a closed enum mapped to pipeline categories while format/topic carry the free text that used to pollute the type field.

nodes.label: derive_aggregates_from_slots
nodes.rationale: Back-compat layer: components that never learn about slots (paper_audit, frontend read-only pages, ExamPattern.save totals) still see consistent aggregates recomputed from slots.

nodes.label: validate_pattern_structure (core/pattern_structure.py)
nodes.rationale: Teacher-source arithmetic conflicts (9 questions declared vs 7 marks) surface at pattern time as warnings via one repair call instead of silently reshaping the printed paper; residual errors are stored as _structure_warnings and the pattern still saves so generation falls back gracefully.

nodes.label: Slot-Driven Work Orders (build_work_orders)
nodes.rationale: When a section has question_slots, SectionWorkOrder.slots carries the normalized slots and the heuristic inference chain (mpq-list patching, subsection synthesis, typical-marks fallbacks) is bypassed entirely.

nodes.label: PER-QUESTION SPEC Prompt Block
nodes.rationale: Slot sections get a per-question spec block instead of the derived qpos_block; topic strings finally reach the generation LLM; or_alternative is required only on choice=='internal' slots while the LA-blanket OR rule stays for slot-less sections.

nodes.label: Slot-Aware Rendering (no regroup/re-stamp)
nodes.rationale: Skipping _regroup_section reordering and _section_type_marks re-stamping for slot-driven sections retires the two recurring bug families: category marks stamping and printed-vs-storage qnum divergence.

edges.source_location: free-form types classify to 'other' and disable type enforcement
